name: Grilled snakehead
summary: Cá lóc nướng is grilled snakehead, one of the plates Can Tho is known for. At the Mỹ Khánh garden village it is served as cá lóc nướng trui.
origin: Can Tho and the Mỹ Khánh garden village.
howToEat: Order it as a main at the Mỹ Khánh garden tables at midday, after the orchards.
seoDescription: Grilled snakehead in Can Tho, and cá lóc nướng trui at the Mỹ Khánh garden village.
